entry.description: `FileAppender.Flush(int)` with `ImmediateFlush=false` no longer drops the buffered text and returns `false`: it takes the file lock and writes the text. With `InterProcessLock` and `MinimalLock` nothing is left buffered, as they flush before each release, so it returns immediately (ANT-2026-98BDXCN5, fixed by @FreeAndNil)
